text.arabic_uthmani: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening interrogative plus consequential connector; launches a challenge that follows from the prior disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:ʾa-fa}}) does not merely begin a new sentence. Its interrogative onset makes the ayah start as a challenge, while the attached consequential connector ties that challenge to the disclosure just before it (52:14). The opening therefore converts the shown fire into an immediate test: is the problem in what is being shown, or in the people being addressed? Even the compact sound of the opening particles helps the line feel clipped and prosecutorial before the final perception verb lands.

topics.headline: question launched as consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is not detached; it asks as a consequence of the disclosed scene.
topics.reason: The bundle identifies the token as interrogative hamza plus consequential connector, and translation support warns that the sequence should be kept as a two-member challenge rather than flattened into unrelated statements.

topics.headline: prior disclosure carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 52:15 as the continuation of the fire-disclosure in 52:14, not as an isolated question.
topics.reason: The prior ayah supplies the concrete antecedent for the consequential connector, and the discourse rows describe the shift from showing the fire to examining the addressees' explanation.

topics.headline: interrogative rebuke with two beats
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question form becomes a rebuke by staging object first and observer second.
topics.reason: The grammar preserves an interrogative opening, while the local two-clause architecture and context make neutral information-seeking implausible.

topics.headline: compact particle cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening as compressed and abrupt, matching the prosecutorial force of the question.
topics.reason: The surface token fuses two bound particles into a short launch-form; the sound rows add cadence payoff without changing the syntactic analysis.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite fronted predicate meaning sorcery or deceptive illusion as a proposed classification of the disclosed reality
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range includes magic as deception and diversion, predawn liminality, and unrelated branches such as organ, food, plant, toy, and edge; the local noun selects the magic-deception branch while predawn threshold imagery remains only a narrow coloring
words.prose: {{ar:سِحْرٌ}} ({{tr:siḥrun}}) is the first content label, and its fronted indefinite predicate form makes the accusation arrive before the pointer. The word tests a category: not a named magician or victim, but the explanation "some sorcery" imposed on what has just been disclosed. Its active branch is the deception or appearance-reality inversion of {{ar:س ح ر}} ({{tr:s-ḥ-r}}); the predawn threshold association can color the seeing-not-seeing field, but it does not replace the local sense. The familiar magic-accusation field is turned back into a self-indicting question here (10:2, 38:4, 74:24). Because the ayah later closes on perception failure, this magic label becomes the first pole in an illusion-versus-sight audit, and its compact sound is tied into that contrast without becoming the lexical sense.

topics.headline: fronted indefinite category label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputed label is foregrounded before the thing being pointed at.
topics.reason: Local syntax identifies the noun as a nominative fronted predicate before the delayed demonstrative subject, and the indefinite form makes it a classifying label.

topics.headline: reality mislabeled as illusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the magic label is an epistemic misclassification of disclosed reality, not a neutral note of wonder.
topics.reason: V4 supports the magic-deception branch for the local noun, while other root branches are not locally activated; predawn and threshold imagery may remain as a narrow secondary coloring only.

topics.headline: accusation formula turned back
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a known magic-accusation field being turned into a question that indicts the accusers (10:2, 38:4, 74:24).
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows the noun often appears in quoted accusation settings, and the CRITICAL rows give concrete formula parallels (10:2, 38:4, 74:24).

topics.headline: illusion versus sight pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first content root sets up the ayah-wide contrast between calling reality illusion and failing to perceive it.
topics.reason: The row family ties this noun to the final perception verb as the two semantic poles of the binary question.

topics.headline: sound binds the contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the compact indefinite label linked by sound to the later denied faculty, without treating sound as the lexical sense.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe partial sibilant, rhotic, and nasal links; these support cadence and cohesion but do not override the noun's semantic branch.

words.gloss_range: proximal masculine singular demonstrative; delayed subject pointing to the disclosed fire, punishment scene, or broader presented reality without forcing one referent
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَآ}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) lands after the accusation, so the listener hears the proposed label before the pointer resolves what is being labeled. As a near demonstrative, it keeps the scene present before the addressees; as a compact masculine pointer, it can carry the fire disclosed in 52:14 while also broadening toward the whole encountered judgment reality. Its lengthened deictic landing gives that pointer audible presence rather than making it a throwaway replacement for a repeated noun. The word therefore supplies the object side of the ayah's object-to-observer pivot.

topics.headline: pointer delayed after label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the label is processed before the demonstrative referent is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the demonstrative as the delayed subject after the fronted predicate, so the processing order is grammatically licensed.

topics.headline: near pointer with open scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the fire of 52:14 in view without prematurely reducing the pointer to only one noun.
topics.reason: Reference evidence marks the demonstrative as ambiguous: it points to the presented fire or judgment scene, and translation support warns against forcing a single explicit noun.

topics.headline: object side of the audit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the demonstrative as one pole of the ayah's audit: this object first, then the addressed observers.
topics.reason: The clause structure places the demonstrative at the close of the first beat, where it completes the object being classified before the second beat shifts to the addressees.

topics.headline: audible deictic landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pointer as a perceptible landing rather than a throwaway replacement for a repeated noun.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the free demonstrative form and its lengthened recitational shape to the local deictic payoff.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive particle introducing the second member of the question; can be heard as either connected alternative or corrective escalation
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:ʾam}}) is the hinge where the question turns. It can hold the two halves together as an either-or, and it can also sharpen the second half as a corrective "rather" accusation. Either way, the particle does not let the final clause float as a comment; it redirects blame from the object being called illusion to the observers who do not perceive. Its nasal handoff into the following pronoun makes the pivot audibly land on the addressees, and its disjunctive pressure anticipates the next ayah's endurance alternative (52:16).

topics.headline: either-or and corrective force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears both a logical alternative and a rhetorical tilt toward the second accusation.
topics.reason: The grammar licenses the particle as the disjunctive between the two clauses, while the CRITICAL rows preserve both connected and disconnected readings as locally productive.

topics.headline: two damaging explanations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the particle narrows the live explanations so both available answers indict denial.
topics.reason: Translation support says the sequence should remain a two-member challenge, and the CRITICAL rows identify the disjunction as a rhetorical trap rather than neutral information gathering.

topics.headline: hinge from object to subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the blame change direction at the particle: object-accusation first, subject-indictment second.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates two separate clause beats and prevents the second from reading as loose apposition.

topics.headline: audible pivot into address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the standalone pivot carry interrogation into direct address and forward into the next disjunction (52:16).
topics.reason: The free particle occupies an independent hinge slot; sound and boundary rows add audible and inter-ayah payoff without altering the clause analysis.

words.gloss_range: explicit second-person plural independent pronoun; emphatic subject of the negated perception clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾantum}}) is not needed merely to mark the subject, because the final verb already carries second-person plural agreement. Its independent placement makes the addressees themselves stand before the negation: the question turns from "is this illusion?" to "is it you who fail to perceive?" Coming immediately after the disjunctive hinge, the pronoun also receives the audible handoff of the pivot. The pronoun therefore relocates responsibility onto the observers and makes the second beat a direct confrontation rather than a neutral description.

topics.headline: retained pronoun intensifies you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees are explicitly singled out even though the verb could mark them by itself.
topics.reason: The final verb has second-person plural agreement, so the independent pronoun creates visible emphasis rather than merely supplying missing person marking.

topics.headline: observers become responsible agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the problem shift from an external object to the addressed selves as responsible perceivers.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following negated verbal clause the predicate for the explicit pronoun, so the subject role is locally assigned to the addressees.

topics.headline: pivot from this to you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's referential pivot from the object being judged to the people judging it.
topics.reason: The first beat centers the demonstrative object, while the second beat begins with the independent personal pronoun as the subject of denied perception.

topics.headline: sound lands on addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pivot settle audibly on the addressed group.
topics.reason: The sound row is local to the particle-pronoun boundary and supports audible emphasis on the addressees without adding a new syntactic claim.

words.gloss_range: negative particle with narrow scope over the following imperfect perception verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) supplies the denial at the center of the second beat. Its scope is narrow: it negates the following perception verb, not the whole binary question or the demonstrative object. Because the verb it governs spans sight and discernment, the particle lets the accusation remain both sensory and cognitive, and because it negates an imperfect verb, the failure sounds continuing rather than a single missed glance. It also leaves incapacity and refusal open, so the rebuke can press both what they cannot see and what they will not perceive. That negation then points forward from perception failure here to the endurance alternative in the next ayah (52:16).

topics.headline: narrow ongoing negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle denies the act of perceiving as a continuing state, not the whole question.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the particle as syntactically forced over the imperfect verb, and translation support warns against broadening the scope beyond that verb.

topics.headline: sight and discernment denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the negation holds together physical non-seeing, cognitive non-perception, incapacity, and refusal.
topics.reason: The governed verb's perception field supports both sensory and cognitive force, while the particle itself simply denies the verb and does not choose between inability and volitional neglect.

topics.headline: negation bridges you and perceive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second clause is built around negating the addressees' faculty.
topics.reason: The particle sits between the explicit subject and the perception verb, making denied perception the grammatical bridge in the second beat.

topics.headline: negation carries into next ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial of perception leading into the next denial around endurance (52:16).
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete forward bridge from negated perception in 52:15 to the next ayah's negated endurance alternative (52:16).

words.gloss_range: second-person masculine plural Form IV imperfect: you perceive or see with engaged visual-cognitive force, negated without an explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range includes eyesight, inner insight, visibility-giving clarification, and unrelated branches such as blood trace, armor, edge, and bright stone-ground; the local Form IV verb selects seeing/perceiving with insight-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تُبْصِرُونَ}} ({{tr:tubṣirūn}}) is where the ayah lands. The imperfect active verb keeps the addressees responsible as ongoing perceivers, and the second-person plural ending repeats the explicit pronoun so the final sound still points at them. Because the verb has no explicit object, the failure is broader than not seeing one named item. The Form IV verb from {{ar:ب ص ر}} ({{tr:b-ṣ-r}}) carries sight with discernment, so the negation denies engaged perception of reality itself, and the ayah isolates sight rather than pairing it with hearing. As the final word, it answers the opening magic label: the decisive problem is not that the object is illusion, but that the observers do not perceive. The same magic-perception field appears in wider pairings (21:3, 27:13, 15:15), while locally the failure diagnosed after 52:14 moves toward compulsory encounter in 52:16. Its final cadence and partial sound echo reinforce that closure on denied sight.

topics.headline: active addressees remain responsible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verb keeps the addressees actively responsible through the ayah's close.
topics.reason: The verb is active, imperfect, and second-person plural, with agreement controlled by the explicit pronoun; the form therefore keeps the perceiving role on the addressees.

topics.headline: failure wider than one object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the clause denies a perceptual faculty, not only failure to notice one supplied object.
topics.reason: The local frame marks no explicit object, and valency evidence confirms objectless use is ordinary for this form; the row's absolute wording is kept without forcing an impossible object.

topics.headline: engaged sight and insight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied seeing includes discernment and engaged perception, not bare optical reception.
topics.reason: V4 accepts both eye-sight and inner-sight branches, and the local Form IV verb supports engaged perception while unrelated root branches remain outside the local sense.

topics.headline: visual evidence isolated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah chooses sight as the evidentiary channel instead of pairing it with hearing.
topics.reason: The perception verb is visual-cognitive, and the CRITICAL rows note that the usual sight-hearing pair is reduced here to sight alone, matching the deictic scene.

topics.headline: final perception answers magic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word makes sight-failure the answer to the opening magic claim.
topics.reason: The ayah's first content label and final verb form a local semantic antithesis: illusion or concealment is answered by denied perception at closure.

topics.headline: echo into wider and adjacent scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the local contrast participate in wider magic-perception pairings (21:3, 27:13, 15:15) and move from denied sight in 52:15 to compulsory encounter in 52:16.
topics.reason: The row family gives concrete cross-surah pair references (21:3, 27:13, 15:15), a backward link to denial in 52:14, and a forward link to compelled encounter in 52:16.

topics.headline: sound closes on denied sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final verb's sound and ending reinforce the closure on perception failure.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe partial echo with the magic noun, final plural cadence, and articulation that support closure and cohesion without changing the lexical sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus opposes sihr at word 1 to the addressees' failure to tubsiru at word 6 through am.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question allocates a mismatch between reality and recognition to two possible sites: an appearance diverted from its true face, or viewers whose outer and inward sight fail. The alternatives can coexist because deception succeeds through a receptive failure.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and deception supply the object-side possibility that the thing's apparent face has been manipulated.
Eye-sight supplies the literal perceptual capacity whose failure the second question tests.
Inner sight supplies recognition and self-witness, making non-seeing an epistemic failure as well as an optical one.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sihr, the demonstrative 'this,' am, and the plural seeing verb form a compact switch between two presentations of one object.
baseline_models.mechanism: The color-changing toy branch makes am resemble a two-sided pull: draw from one side and 'this' appears as magic; draw from the other and the same display exposes the observers' failure. The referent stays fixed while its assigned color changes.

activation_trace.role: A toy showing different colors when pulled from opposite sides supplies the viewpoint-switch mechanism for am.
Actual eye-sight keeps the model tied to how one stable display is visually received.

changed_reading.before: Two unrelated accusations are placed side by side.
changed_reading.after: The syntax toggles two incompatible colorings of the same 'this,' exposing attribution itself as unstable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root for sihr also carries predawn and edge images, while tubsirun names both seeing and recognition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Predawn is an edge where blackness acquires light but objects remain contestable. The question can therefore stage a threshold test: is the emerging form deceptive, or have the observers not yet crossed from retinal exposure into recognition?

activation_trace.role: The last part of night before morning supplies a temporal threshold of changing visibility.
The edge or upper end of a thing supplies the spatial form of that threshold.
Inner sight marks the crossing from a visible outline to verified recognition.

changed_reading.after: Non-seeing is a failure to cross a liminal interval in which evidence is already emerging but not yet acknowledged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening constructs disclosure as joined letters, aligned writing, a written sheet, and an opened spread. This activates a legibility model in which 'not seeing' means failing to read an exposed record, not merely missing a visual object.

activation_trace.role: Insight and verification let visual seeing extend into reading disclosed evidence.
Letters organized as writing supply an intelligible rather than merely visible display.
Writing aligned in rows supplies ordered marks that ask to be read correctly.
The written sheet gives the disclosure a public material surface.
Opening and spreading remove enclosure, making failure to recognize harder to blame on concealment.

structural_cues: 52:2-3 move from writing to its material sheet and then to that sheet's being opened and spread before the focus challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, aligned rows, a sheet, and spreading; I infer that inward sight can read this public display. The live alternative is that the opening oath establishes solemnity without identifying what 'this' in 52:15 denotes.

changed_reading.before: The verse tests whether an object is visually perceived.
changed_reading.after: It also tests whether an already exposed configuration of signs is being read as what it is.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky-wave and mountain-displacement remove the viewer's usual stable reference frame. The focus's two-pull color branch then becomes a model of categorization under radical motion: observers can call the transformed field magic because they cannot preserve recognition when the frame itself moves.

activation_trace.role: The opposite-color display models a scene whose appearance changes when its frame is pulled another way.
Eye-sight anchors the changed frame in concrete visual perception.
Oscillation and wave-like motion make the encompassing visual field unstable.
A hard elevated mass supplies the normally fixed landmark whose movement should be unmistakable.
Removal and displacement turn the fixed landmark into a departing element of the scene.

structural_cues: 52:9-10 use cognate repetitions for the sky's motion and the mountains' motion immediately before the denial sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a waving sky and displaced solid mountains; I infer that loss of a stable frame motivates the fallback label 'magic.' The alternative is that these are simply future events whose motion does not explain the addressees' present classification.

changed_reading.before: The addressees fail to see one isolated thing.
changed_reading.after: They fail to retain truthful recognition when the whole visual coordinate system ceases to behave normally.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately named fire is luminous and visible from afar, yet it is the very thing previously denied. The repeated demonstrative converts the magic question into an exposed evasion: an object with its own visibility is being renamed so prior denial can survive contact with it.

activation_trace.role: Diversion from a thing's true face supplies the evasive renaming of present reality as magic.
Inner sight distinguishes sensory exposure from acknowledgment of what the exposure proves.
Fire visible from a distance supplies an object whose disclosure precedes any close bodily test.
Attributing falsehood supplies the prior commitment that the new magic label protects.

structural_cues: 52:13 drives the addressees toward fire, 52:14 points to 'this fire' and recalls denial, and 52:15 immediately repeats the deictic challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediately preceding visible fire, denial, and repeated deixis; I infer that 52:15 confronts the same experienced reality under a new label. The alternative is that 'this' points more broadly to punishment rather than strictly resuming the noun fire.

changed_reading.before: Magic and blindness are neutral rival explanations.
changed_reading.after: Magic is a replacement label recruited after denial fails, while non-seeing names refusal to recognize an already disclosed referent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah replaces visual dispute with meeting heat, then makes endurance and non-endurance equal. Direct causal contact therefore acts as an ablation of the magic label: changing one's description or stance no longer changes what the fire does.

activation_trace.role: Deceptive diversion supplies the hypothesis that bodily contact is about to test.
Eye-sight is the initial evidence channel that the following heat encounter overtakes.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies direct bodily verification beyond disputed appearance.
The second mapped root independently preserves the same heat-contact image as part of the verification mechanism.
Equality between two responses makes altered stance causally irrelevant to the encountered result.

structural_cues: 52:16 follows the sight question with an imperative of entry and the explicit equivalence of patience and non-patience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat-contact and equal outcomes; I infer that contact functions as a reality test and stance-indifference as its control. The alternative is that 52:16 only intensifies punishment and does not intentionally stage an epistemic experiment.

changed_reading.before: The verse leaves appearance and perceptual failure in verbal competition.
changed_reading.after: The question is the last verbal off-ramp before causal contact renders both denial and its replacement label ineffective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later accusations cycle through hidden-news specialist, mind-covered madman, and poet. This makes 'magic' one member of a rotating taxonomy that relocates difficulty into the messenger or display whenever the content resists dismissal.

activation_trace.role: Deception supplies the focus's first defensive classification of unwelcome disclosure.
A claimant to hidden reports supplies a second way to discredit the source rather than assess the message.
A covered mind supplies an incompatible but functionally interchangeable dismissal.
Poetic composition supplies another genre-label that can replace examination of truth.

structural_cues: From 52:29 onward, accusations are followed by a long repeated-am interrogation that keeps changing the proposed explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several mutually different labels in a repeated interrogative sequence; I infer that their shared function is defensive reclassification. The alternative is that each label records a separate historical allegation and should not be treated as one adaptive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Calling the displayed reality magic is a single mistaken judgment.
changed_reading.after: It is one replaceable output of a label-generating defense that preserves non-recognition across contradictory explanations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene explicitly grants sight of a detached piece falling from above, then records its recoding as stacked cloud. Thus 'you do not see' need not deny retinal registration: it can diagnose the interval in which perception is deliberated into a harmless category.

activation_trace.role: Diversion from the true face of a thing supplies the recoding operation performed after sight.
Insight distinguishes visual intake from the recognition that the intake warrants.
Eye and inward seeing establish that the scene is registered rather than simply invisible.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes deliberation, locating failure in post-perceptual interpretation.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies the threatening object actually presented to sight.
Downward falling supplies the event that the later cloud label must neutralize.
A drawn-along cloud supplies the harmless substitute category assigned to the falling piece.
Layering one thing over another completes the plausible visual description used to cover the event's import.

structural_cues: 52:44 orders the acts as seeing, object specification, falling, then speaking a replacement description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies registered sight, a falling sky-piece, and the spoken category 'stacked cloud'; I infer that classification neutralizes evidence after perception. The live alternative is sincere misperception under an ambiguous sky rather than motivated evasion.

changed_reading.before: Not seeing means no visual registration.
changed_reading.after: Not seeing can mean seeing the data while recoding it quickly enough to prevent recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement places widespread non-knowledge beside the messenger's being under observing and caring eyes. This reverses the focus's gaze: those unable to recognize are not hidden, while the one they misclassify is held within a fully attentive field.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies the failed recognition that becomes one side of the asymmetric gaze.
A thing becoming disclosed to the knower broadens non-seeing into persistent non-knowledge.
Direct observation supplies the counter-gaze under which the disputed messenger remains fully visible.
Watchful preservation keeps that gaze from collapsing into surveillance alone.

structural_cues: 52:47 speaks of the majority's lack of knowledge, then 52:48 shifts to the singular messenger and places him under 'Our eyes.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-knowledge followed by observation and care; I infer a reversal between failed human seeing and comprehensive counter-seeing. The alternatives are significant: the subject changes, and the eye construction may foreground protection rather than observation.

changed_reading.before: The focus only accuses the addressed group of defective sight.
changed_reading.after: Their defective gaze is enclosed by a larger gaze that sees and preserves the person they misread.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close specifies an appointed time, night, the last phase of something, and stars moving into their aftermath. These cues activate the focus root's predawn and edge branches: the sight question can echo at the precise interval when darkness is losing its authority and visible points are changing status.

activation_trace.role: Predawn supplies the latent temporal reading activated by the surah's night close.
An edge supplies the liminal geometry between darkness and disclosure.
Eye-sight makes changing nocturnal visibility the model's concrete test.
The proper time of an act prepares a temporally exact rather than generic night setting.
Night and its darkness supply the field from which visibility must emerge.
The last part and passing aftermath supply night at its receding edge.
A rising visible point supplies the stellar markers whose departure measures the transition.

structural_cues: 52:48-49 move from an appointed moment of rising to night and the retreat or aftermath of the stars at the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies time, night, final phase, and stars; I infer that these cues wake the focus root's predawn homonym and edge image. This does not claim that sihr in 52:15 lexically means predawn; the live alternative is that the closing worship schedule is unrelated to the focus's magic sense.

changed_reading.before: The focus is only a dispute over a present object.
changed_reading.after: It can also reverberate as a threshold challenge: when darkness is visibly ending, will emergence still be called illusion?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses material edge senses far from ordinary magic and sight semantics. It remains anchored in both focus roots and in am joining two explanations; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for attribution, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins an edge-bearing sihr root to a basar root that can name a thick joined edge.

activation_trace.role: The edge of a thing supplies one side of a material boundary between object and observer.
A thick seam joining two panels supplies the question's functional joint between external distortion and perceptual failure.

changed_reading.after: Am also marks the seam where responsibility is stitched between what appears and the one who sees.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the anatomical sahr branch is remote from the ordinary noun sihr. Its scope explicitly includes upper chest or throat and fear-swelling, while the focus itself asks about seeing; downstream prose should retain it only as an embodied panic model, not as the verse's lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both the sahr-organ branch and the eye-sight branch occur on the focus ayah's two content roots.

activation_trace.role: The upper chest and throat region, including swelling with fear, supplies an embodied constriction between encounter and response.
Eye-sight supplies the faculty that panic may narrow without removing sensory exposure altogether.

changed_reading.before: Failure to see is purely intellectual or optical.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting embodied model treats fear's chest-throat constriction as helping convert overwhelming sight into the defensive word 'magic.'

strongest_changes: The immediate fire-and-denial sequence turns 'magic' from a neutral option into an evasive replacement label for a present luminous reality.
The next ayah's heat-contact and equal outcomes move the dispute from appearance to causal verification.
52:44 proves that sight and non-seeing can coexist: the event is visually registered and then recoded as harmless cloud.
The night and departing-star close keeps a contained predawn threshold reading alive without replacing the ordinary magic sense.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's short disjunction opened several mechanisms at once: fault allocation between object and observer, post-perceptual relabeling, a rotating social taxonomy of dismissal, unstable reference frames, and temporal or bodily thresholds. The odd branch activations changed the reading rather than merely decorating it, so they remain alongside the strong denial model.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 'this' in 52:15 resumes the fire specifically or the punishment scene more broadly.
Whether 52:44 depicts motivated recoding or a sincere but culpable perceptual mistake.
Whether the closing night sequence intentionally activates the predawn sahr branch or only creates a retrospective lexical resonance.
Whether the eye construction in 52:48 should weight protective care more heavily than counter-observation.

facets.statement: Yanlışı doğru görünümünde sunarak kişiyi aldatır veya gözün gerçekte olmayan bir şeyi varmış gibi algılamasına yol açar.
Bazı anlatımlarda gizli güçlerden yardım alma ya da onlara yaklaşma yoluyla yapılan doğaüstü işlem olarak sınırlandırılır.
Çok etkili ve ustalıklı söz, gönülleri konuşanın yönüne çevirdiği için aynı saptırıcı güce benzetilir.
Birini bulunduğu yönden çevirmek, kandırmak veya olağan durumundan uzaklaştırmak fiil olarak bu çekirdeği sürdürür.
Yiyeceğin işlevinin bozulması, toprağın ürün vermemesi, keçinin sütünün azalması veya aşırı yağmurun zarar vermesi gibi sonuçlara genişletilir.

facets.statement: Gecenin son parçasını ve sabah ışığının belirmesinden hemen önceki vakti belirtir.

Vaktin üst ucu, sabahın ilk soluklanmasının başladığı en ileri bölüm olarak ayrılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم بالشيء ونفاذ القلب والمعرفة والتحقق والاستبصار في الدين والحجة والعبرة وشهادة الإنسان على نفسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد حاسة العين ولا اللمعان الحسي ولا الدم ولا السلاح ولا الحجارة ولا الخياطة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما العلم بالشيء وبصرت بالشيء إذا صرت به بصيرا عالما والبصيرة البرهان (maqayis)؛ البصر نفاذ في القلب والبصيرة اسم لما اعتقد في القلب من الدين وحقيق الأمر واستبصر في أمره ودينه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ حسن البصيرة إذا كان مستبصرا في دينه (jamhara)؛ البصر العلم وبصرت بالشيء علمته والتبصر التأمل والتعرف والبصيرة الحجة والاستبصار في الشيء (sihah)؛ لقوة القلب المدركة بصيرة وبصر وعلى معرفة وتحقق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yalnızca ışıklı oluşa indirmez; aydınlatan, açık kılan, kendisiyle görülen veya insanları görür hale getiren işlevleri birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dal kabul edilebilir, fakat tanım hem aydınlık hem de açıklayıcı işlevi birlikte taşımalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görmeyi veya anlamayı mümkün kılan açıklıkla sınırlıdır; göz organı ya da yalın iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin aydınlatıcı ve açıklayıcı işlevini verir; kalıba bağlı ayrı bir anlam genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin aydınlık, açık veya açıklayıcı olup görmeyi ya da anlamayı mümkün kılması. Bu alan, işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesiyle tanımlanır.

facets.statement: Aydınlatıcı veya açık kılıcı nitelik, görmeyi ve anlamayı mümkün kılar.
Bir işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesi bu çekirdeğin nedensel uzantısıdır.
Açıklama ve belirgin kılma eylemi aynı alan içinde kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda aydınlık, açıklık, kendisiyle görülme ve insanları görür hale getirme yönlerini bir araya getirir. Ayrıca açıklama ve belirgin kılma anlamı aynı toplu iddiada desteklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem ışıkla görünür kılmayı hem de açık seçik gösterme işlevini birlikte verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal görmeyi sağlayan açıklık veya işarettir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aydınlık, ortaya çıkma ve aynı kökün gözle görme dalı sınırı en kullanışlı ayrımları sağladı. Diğer adaylar biçim, açık oluş veya yorum alanlarında daha dolaylı kaldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يوصف بأنه مبصر بمعنى مضيء أو بين أو مبصر به أو جاعل للناس بصراء، والتبصرة بمعنى التبيين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه عين الإنسان نفسها ولا العلم المجرد عن إظهار أو إضاءة ولا حجارة البصرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المبصرة المضيئة تبصرهم أي تجعلهم بصراء والمبصرة بالفتح الحجة (sihah)؛ مبصرة مضيئة وتبين لهم ومبصرا بها (tahdhib)؛ آياتنا مبصرة أي مضيئة للأبصار وقيل صار أهله بصراء وتبصرة أي تبصيرا وتبيانا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kanın yerdeki yuvarlak parçası, bedendeki yolları, izi, küçük miktarı ve şiirde kan bedeli veya öç bağlamı olarak verir. Dalın kimliği kan lekesi veya kan izi alanıdır; iç kavrayış ve silah anlamları yalnızca eş adlı başka dallardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kan parçası, izi, lekesi ve buna bağlı şiirsel kan bedeli veya öç kullanımıdır; göz ve bilgi alanı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kan parçası ve izi anlamını verir; başka dallardaki eş adlı kullanımlar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yere veya bedene düşen kan parçası, kan lekesi ya da kan izi; bağlama göre bu izden hareketle kan bedeli veya öç konusu da anılır. Çekirdek, somut kan kalıntısı ve onun izleyici işaret oluşudur.

facets.statement: Yerde veya bedende görülen kan parçası, leke ya da iz çekirdektir.
Yerde yuvarlaklaşan veya parlayan küçük kan miktarı özel olarak belirtilir.
Kan izi, yaralanmayı veya atışı gösteren bir belirti olarak kullanılabilir.
Şiirsel kullanımlarda kan bedeli, kan davası veya öç anlamı bu kan alanına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak iddiası bu dalı somut kan izi ve kan parçası olarak kurar: yerdeki parça, bedendeki yol veya yarayı gösteren belirti. Aynı toplu iddia şiir bağlamında kan bedeli ve öç bağlantılarını da çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

error_profile.preserves: Somut kan kalıntısı ve işaret oluşunu korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصيرة من الدم: القطعة أو الطريقة أو المقدار على الأرض أو الجسد، وما اتصل بها من ثأر أو دية في الشعر.

branches.source_phrase_ar: البصيرة القطعة من الدم إذا وقعت بالأرض استدارت (maqayis;jamhara)؛ بصائر الدماء طرائقها على الجسد (ayn)؛ البصيرة من الدم ما كان على الأرض وشيء من الدم يستدل به على الرمية (sihah)؛ بصيرة من دم والجدية منها على الأرض والبصيرة الدية ومقدار الدرهم من الدم (tahdhib)؛ البصيرة قطعة من الدم تلمع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kalkan, zırh ve savaşta giyilen koruyucu donanım anlamında toplar. Bazı ifadelerde parlaklık veya şiir tanıklığı bulunsa da dalın çekirdeği koruyucu silah nesnesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kalkan, zırh ve giyilen savaş korumasıdır; kan lekesi, iç kavrayış ve kumaş dikişi anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın koruyucu savaş nesnesi anlamını verir; başka eş adlı dallar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Savaşta korunmak için kullanılan kalkan, zırh veya giyilen koruyucu silah donanımı. Parlaklık ya da şiirsel tanıklık, nesnenin kendisine bağlı ayrıntıdır.

facets.statement: Kalkan, zırh veya giyilen koruyucu savaş nesnesi çekirdektir.
Kaynaklar kalkan ile zırh arasında değişen adlandırmalar verir, fakat ikisi de koruyucu silah alanındadır.
Parlak kalkan niteliği nesnenin olası betimleyici yönüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak iddiası bu dalı koruyucu savaş gereci olarak verir: kalkan, zırh veya giyilen silah. Kalkan ile zırh arasındaki farklı adlandırma çekirdek alanı değiştirmez; hepsi koruma nesnesi çerçevesindedir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesnenin kalın kenarı, yanı ve iki parça arasını dikme veya birleştirme alanıdır; taş, göz ve iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kalın kenar ve birleştirici dikiş alanını verir; başka kalıplardan ek anlam alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kalın dış yanı, kenarı veya yüzeyi ve iki deri, kumaş ya da kap parçasını bir araya getirip dikilen ara bölüm. Dal, kalın kenar fikri ile parçaları ek yerinden birleştirme fikrini aynı maddi yüzey alanında tutar.

facets.statement: Nesnenin kalın dış yanı, kenarı, yüzeyi veya yönü çekirdeğin bir bölümüdür.
İki deri, kumaş veya kap parçasının ek yerinden dikilip birleştirilmesi çekirdeğin diğer bölümüdür.
Çadır, elbise veya su kabı parçaları arasındaki şerit ya da bölüm bu birleştirme alanının özel nesnesidir.
İki parça arasında yamanmış veya eklenmiş şey aynı alanın sonuç nesnesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kalınlık, yan, kenar ve dış yüzey anlamlarını iki parça arasını dikme ve ek yeri nesnesiyle birlikte verir. Toplu iddia, çadır, elbise, deri ve su kabı gibi maddi örnekleri aynı kenar ve birleştirme alanına bağlar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه غلظ الشيء وجلده أو جانبه وحرفه، وخياطة أديم إلى أديم أو ما بين شقتي البيت أو الثوب أو المزادة، والقطعة الملفقة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه حجارة البصرة الرخوة ولا حاسة البصر ولا بصيرة القلب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بصر الشيء غلظه والبصر هو أن يضم أديم إلى أديم يخاطان والبصيرة ما بين شقتي البيت (maqayis)؛ البصر غلظ الشيء نحو بصر الجبل والسماء والحائط (ayn)؛ بصر كل شيء جلده الظاهر وثوب ذو بصر إذا كان غليظا وثيجا (jamhara)؛ البصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم والبصر بالضم الجانب والحرف من كل شيء وغلظها (sihah)؛ الباصر الملفق بين شقتين والبصيرة الشقة التي تكون على الخباء والبصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم (tahdhib)؛ البصر الناحية والبصيرة ما بين شقتي الثوب والمزادة وبصرت الثوب والأديم إذا خطت ذلك الموضع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yumuşak, parlak veya beyaza çalan taşlar ve bu taşlı yer adıyla açıklar; ayrıca bu yer adına gitme kalıbı verilir. Dalın çekirdeği taş türü ve taşlı yerdir, başka yer adları veya nispetler dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taş ve bu taşlı yer anlamıdır; göz, iç kavrayış, dikiş ve dış yer adları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak taş ve taşlı yer anlamını temel alır; o yere gitme kalıbı bağlı kullanım olarak ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar ve böyle taşları bulunan yer. Bu yer adından hareketle oraya gitme kullanımı çekirdeğe bağlı bir yönelme kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar çekirdektir.
Bu taşların bulunduğu arazi veya yer adı aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
Bu adla anılan yere varmak veya gitmek bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımdır.
Kaynaklar yumuşaklık, parlaklık, beyazlık ve alçımsı arazi niteliklerini aynı taş alanında toplar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda yumuşak taş, parlak taş, beyaza çalan taş ve böyle taşlı arazi niteliklerini birleştirir. Aynı toplu iddia, bu taşlı yer adından türeyen oraya gitme kullanımını da bağlı bir kullanım olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taş türünün yumuşaklık, parlaklık ve beyazımsı görünüm niteliklerini kısa biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Taş maddesini, yumuşaklığı, parlaklığı ve taşlı yer uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz taşlarıyla adlandırılmış arazi veya yer için kullanıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Taşlı arazi veya yer uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Taşın yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı niteliğini daraltır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصرة والبصر بمعنى الحجارة الرخوة أو البراقة أو المائلة إلى البياض، والأرض المسماة بذلك، ومنه تسمية البصرة والإتيان إليها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بصرى الشام ولا الأباصر ولا السيف البصري ولا بنصر الإصبع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البصرة الحجارة الرخوة وبصر بكسر الباء من الأصل الثاني (maqayis)؛ البصرة أرض حجارتها جص والبصرة الحجارة التي فيها بعض اللين (ayn)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة وبه سميت البصرة (jamhara)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة إلى البياض وبصر بالكسر (sihah)؛ البصر والبصرة الحجارة البراقة وأرض كأنها جبل من جص وبصر الأرض غلظها وبصر فلان تبصيرا إذا أتى البصرة (tahdhib)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة تلمع ويقال له بصر (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Bu kök çok dallıdır: gözle görme ve iç kavrayış gibi algı temelli dalların yanında açıklık, kan izi, koruyucu savaş gereci, kalın kenar-ek yeri ve yumuşak parlak taş anlamları bulunur. Dallar eş adlı ve kısmen imgesel bağlantılar taşısa da her biri kendi madde, eylem veya kavrayış alanında sınırlandırılmalıdır.
